approval.rationale: Third recipe (needles only): a criss-cross mat of fallen pine needles over black humus, with no moss, plants or leaves of any size. Cooked with a narrow de-light (1/25), a 0.3 wrap band, chroma evening, saturation 0.55 and gain 0.8 (linear median 0.023): the humus patches no longer repeat as blotches and the rust-red needles sit in the cold palette. In game it darkens the floor under the densest Greenmarch and Hollowvale stands and blends into the forest layer.
limitations: A small stone, a pine cone and a dead leaf in the tile still repeat every 4 m at the closest zoom.
The narrow de-light and wide wrap band flatten the needle mat's own light and shade; it reads flatter than real litter.
